pattern: harness: a playtest request runs start, marks, stop through T3's tools
experience: Asked from the app's Run playtest button to playtest a branch, an agent must start the hidden session through harness_session_start, mark what it saw and end with harness_session_stop so the packet is stored.

# Harness

`harness/gw play state` prints the player, inventory and open options as JSON. `harness/gw play press "<label>"` clicks a visible button. `harness/gw play xdo key e` taps Use. `harness/gw play shot <name>` saves a screenshot.

Report each claim as seen or not.
